message.content: It depends on what you’re looking for—genre, critical acclaim, or audience reception—but many critics and audiences agree that **“Parasite”** (2019) was still dominating conversations into 2020, especially after its Oscar wins. If you want something more recent from 2020 itself, **“Tenet”** (2020) was a high‑profile release that sparked a lot of discussion, though opinions were mixed. For a critically acclaimed film that came out in 2020, **“Nomadland”** (2020) received widespread praise and won several awards, including Best Picture at the Oscars. If you prefer a genre film, **“Soul”** (2020) was a standout animated feature that resonated with both kids and adults. Ultimately, the “best” movie will depend on your personal taste and what you’re hoping to get out of the experience.
